business_summary: AB&Company Co.,Ltd. operates directly managed beauty salons in Japan. The company is also involved in the stores franchise business; and interior design business. Its brand salons include HAIR SALON Agu, Men's Salon FADE & LINE, A GRAND UNION, BLEACHi, Men's hair salon FIRST, Benji, CODE.LINE, NYLON, EleRe, and CS made by SHACHU. AB&Company Co., Ltd. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: (주)에이비앤컴퍼니 일본에서 직영 미용실을 운영하고 있습니다. 회사는 매장 프랜차이즈 사업에도 참여하고 있습니다. 인테리어 디자인 사업. 브랜드 살롱으로는 HAIR SALON Agu, Men's Salon FADE & LINE, A GRAND UNION, BLEACHi, Men's hair Salon FIRST, Benji, CODE.LINE, NYLON, EleRe, CS made by SHACHU 등이 있습니다. AB&Company Co., Ltd.는 2009년에 설립되었으며 일본 도쿄에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
